tei:div.tei:p: sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /de las sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren par gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub thob ste/ mdo khams 'bri chu'i rgyud 'dan lung par 'dan khri dpon gyi gdung brgyud shing glang la 'khrungs/ gdung gnyan/ yum de ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma o rgyan gyi yul dngos su gzigs pa zhig yin/ btsas ma thag nas gsung smra ba la thogs pa med/ /thugs dran pas dgung lo gcig nas zin/ skye 'chi'i thugs skyo ste/ dgung lo lnga nas dbu skra rang gis bcad de rang btsun mdzad/ karma pa'i mtshan gsan pa tsam gyis ba spu gzing zhing mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i mos gus khyad par can 'khrungs te nyin zas mi gsol/ mtshan mi gzims par rje kho na thugs la brnag pas sna'i nyams kyang ring pa na yab yum gyis karma pa'i drung du dgung lo drug pa gcig la mjal du brdzangs/ mjal ma thag pha bu 'phrad pa ltar gyur/ mtshan bkra shis dpal 'byor du gsol/ dgung lo brgyad pa la ban sgar ba dang dpal 'byor don grub ste bla ma rnam gnyis las rab tu byung*/ dgung lo dgu nas bcu drug gi bar 'dan chos sder mkhas pa sangs dpal ba'i drung du byams chos rig tshogs/ gtam tshogs 'dul ba gsang 'dus sogs mdo sngags kyi sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ da ni tshe gcig lus gcig la rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa zhig gi sgrub pa snying por byed de/ de yang bdag rkyen rtsa ba'i bla mar rags las par dgongs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa dgung lo bcu dgu pa bu 'bor du bzhugs pa'i sar gcig pur bros nas nyin mtshan la ma ltos par byon pas zhag bco brgyad na mjal/ dpon slob rnam pa gsum lo bdun du 'bral med bsten te khyad par can gyi gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zhing*/ de thams cad thob tsam du ma bzhag par/ dbang gis rgyud smin nges pa/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim rtsa thig rlung gsum gyis rnam smin gyi lus dag pa 'od gsal dang*/ phyag chen gyis snang srid sku gsum du la zlos par mdzad/

nges 'byung dang mos gus byang chub kyi sems gsum la rtsal sbyangs/ dka' spyad kyis sku lus rid cing nyi lhags kyis gdungs pas mtshan mnyan dpon sngo skyog du chags/ dgung lo nyer gsum la da ni dge sbyor chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor klungs su chud par byed pa la dben sa gcig bsten dgos par 'dug snyam du dgongs te zhus pa na/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ de ka gyis/ dang por mdo khams kyi gnas gnyan po rnams dang*/ de nas dbus gtsang gi lho byang gang rigs nas mgo bzung la gnas gnyan po rnams su sgrub pa gyis kho bo yang rim bzhin dbus gtsang du 'ong gsungs pas/ dang por kam po gnas dang du lo gsum/ spang phug na lo gnyis/ de nas dbus su byon te mtshur phur lo gnyis/ thang lha na lo gcig ste me ma bus/ g.yos pa'i zas ma gsol bar rlung dang rig pa'i bcud len kho na lo brgyad mdzad/ spyir yang thos bsam gyi dus su'ang longs spyod shin tu che gang yod grogs po snyom chung la gnang nas ngan ngon las longs mi spyod/ tshogs khang dang tshogs stan tsam ma gtogs pa dge 'dun gyi dkor dang sgos mgron cung zad kyang dang du mi bzhes/ sgar du bzhugs ring yang ja ro dang gtor lhag sogs kyis 'tsho ba ma gtogs dpon gyi skal pa dang du mi bzhes/ de thams cad du bla ma ma gtoḍa thams cad la gsung bcang te su'i yang ngo mi srung*/ de nas chu shing grogs po la rje karma pas gser bya bral ba dge 'dun rgyal mtshan rdzong ba mdzad de khong gis groḍa byas/ bal bu rtag du dbang lag sogs kyi bcud len kho nas 'tsho ba gnam mtsho'i phyi nang du lo lnga/ mon dom tshang gro bo lung zangs phug sham bu gangs rnams su lo re re bzhugs shing ston dus kyi zla ba gnyis gsum la bsod snyoms cung zad dang*/ de'i ring mdo dbus su rnal 'byor pa gnyan por byed pa dang*/ sprul pa'i gang zag du grags pa dang bzang por grags pa du ma la mjal bsnyen rdzogs dang chos du ma gsan/

dgung lo bzhi bcu pa la nub phyogs o rgyan du 'byon par bzhed nas grogs kyi nyams brtags pa'i phyir kho bo ni shambha lar 'gro 'dod khyod ci snyam gsungs pas gser bya bral ba na re/ a pa rtsed mo min na rung*/ man lung gu ru dang o rgyan pas ma bgrod pa'i gnas bgrod ci nus/ khyed la de tsam gyi blo gdeng yod na rab o rgyan 'bring tu ru ṣka'i yul gyi nags tshal rta rngog can/ tha ma dza landha ra ci snyogs gyis zer te gnyis ka o rgyan du 'byon par byas pa la grogs po kun rdzob byang sems dus min du lhongs pa'i gegs shig nad drag po byung ba la lha sa'i mdze sprang zhig gi shig nad kyang blangs pas khong sku gshegs/ der thugs dgongs la yang bla ma sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i rdo rje phag mo dang o rgyan ga na yod/ grogs de yang 'di 'dras gshegs pa yin srid/ de ni skyid sdug rje karma pa rang mkhyen snyam nas rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ khyod rang bsam mno thong*/ bsam pa gang shar ba de la ngas gnang ba byed/ rmi lam du'ang kho bo ma brjed par gyis 'od gsal zung la gsol ba thos gsungs/ de ltar byas pas mnal lam na mi dkar po gcig na re/ khyod rtsa ba'i ma la lan gcig bltas te chos kyi 'brel pa zhig mi 'dogs sam zer ba byung yum mjal 'dod drag po 'khrungs/ de skad zhus pas mnyes pa'i bka' stsal gnang nas byon lam bar su ri brag tu phebs dus gzigs snang la yum dus las 'das te/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngags skyes kyi ngo bo zhig tu gyur par gzigs te/ bdag sa spyod nas mkha' spyod du gnas spar ba'i phyir bde mchog gi dbang bskur stsol ba rnal 'byor pa chen po mkhyen zhes gsungs pa gzigs pas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur mdzad/ rdo rje'i mgur yang gsungs/ da ni rdza go bo phug gam sle du brag gnam skas can lta bu zhig tu rus phung skya khrol le btang dgos snyam du dgongs/

'cham la kha'i skyo du brag la bzhugs pa na/ yab yul du a gro dang 'dan ma gnyis 'khrug ste khong gi sku mched mi chos kyi yon tan can zhig bsad/ spun zla bya bral ba zhig dbus nas pha yul du yong du yong gi yod zer ba thos nas gshed ma btang ba na gangs khrod kyi pha wang gi skyibs na sho mang dang rtswa shing gi stan la sku skam la rid ba ras hrul gyi gzan gsol ba zhig mthong bas zhe sdang rtsa ba nas zhi dad pa rang dbang med par skyes te ci yod thams cad phul/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis rab tu brtan pa'i nus pas yab tshan dang dgra bo gnyi gas rang re gnyis kyi 'khrug pa mtha' med 'di la rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i slob ma bya bral bkra shis dpal 'byor lta bu dgra gnyen ris med du grol ba de spyan 'drongs na 'khrug pa rtsod med du zhi nus pas de spyan 'dren zer nas gnyi gas spyan drangs pa na lan tsam yang ma gnang bar khra spom brag tu gshegs pa na/ rje karma pas/ khyod kyis dge 'dun gyi sde gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa zhig gyis/ nged dbus su chos 'khor chen mo la 'gro rgyu yin pas de dus 'bul ba yang bskur/ de rnams la slong sna tshogs 'byung yang de thams cad lam du bslong ste byang chub kyi sems kyi grogs su 'gyur zhes pa'i bka' shog phebs pa na bdag yon tan gyi rtsal gang yang ma rdzogs pa la 'di ltar phebs pa snod brtag pa yin dgongs nas slar bskor byar zhus/ sgrub pa mdzad par gsol ba btab rung snga ma ltar bka' nan phebs pa na da bla ma'i bka' kho na mchog gi dngos grub yin dgongs nas dang du bzhes/ a gro dang 'dan yul du phebs/ gnyi ga nas spyan drangs te sa mtshams o rgyan ri khrod du dgung lo zhe gsum la dgon pa btab sha 'khon thams cad sbyangs/ sku mched bkrongs pa'i a gro'i lag dmar rnams la chos dang zang zig gi gnad sbyin rgya cher mdzad pas dad cing gus/

de lo nas khrid skyong bar mdzad ste skal ldan gyi spong ba pa du ma 'dus/ chos sde rgya cher btab/ rtogs ldan a 'gag la sogs pa sprul yul bgrod thub pa'i slob ma du ma thon/ de'i tshe yul de'i sde dgon sngar yod mang pos phrin las ma bzod cing khyim la 'khren pas go mtshon gyi sbyor bas 'ongs pa na gnod par ma nus kyang re zhig rtsod pa zhi bar ma gyur cing de dag gi bsam sbyor zhi ba ma yin pa rgya cher 'phel ba na sa g.yos chen pos de dag gi snod bcud kyang phal cher zhig pas drag po'i phrin las kyi snyan pa yang cher byung nyid khang pa thog so bzhi brtsegs kyi steng na bzhugs pa'i khang pa zhig ste nyid gyang mthon po zhig gi rtser phebs pa na 'phur bar grags te de phyin mnyan pa grub thob du mtshan gsol/ dgon sa klungs su spos te byang chub gling btab/ dung chen stong gi yang sgo sbyar te dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo ches bzang bar sbyar/ de'i tshe rje thams cad mkhyen pas khyod kun spangs kyi brtul zhugs kyis mdo stod smad thams cad du slong mo'i spyod pa gyis shig gsungs pa phebs pas/ de thams cad du byon te kar sde chen po rnams su rnying gso sar 'dzugs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs khrid skyong mtha' yas pa dang rab sgang sogs su chos 'khor chen po rnams kyi gral dbu mdzad de chos brgyud so so ba thams cad kyi mkhas pa dang grub par grags pa thams cad kyis spyi bor bkur yul gru thams cad du 'khon thams cad sbyong zhing zhi bar dums/ dge bskul gyi tshogs ni nyin gcig gi phrin las kyang mtha' yas/ nam mkha'i mdzod lta bu'i longs spyod 'duu ba thams cad rab rnams rje'i drung du phul/ 'bring gis dge rgyun rnams mdzad/ tha mas 'phral dgos dang grwa slob skyong*/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du khrid rwa can gyi 'bul ba 'bum rwa can kyi 'bul ba lan bzhi lnga dang stong rwa can gyi 'bul ba grangs med pa dang*/

rje na rim brgyad pa'i drung du'ang khri 'bul lan mang po dang stong 'bul bgrang gis mi longs par mdzad/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu'ang dge 'dun khri phrag du longs pa'i chos 'khor chen po lan gsum dang spyir gdan sa rnams su 'bul 'gyed mtha' yas pa mdzad/ phyis gser mi bo che'i khur du longs pa thub chen chos 'khor gyi gser thog gi rgyur dmigs pa mdzad/ mdor na rje na rim brgyad pas rnam thar du bdag gi rje bla ma 'di lta bu nang du chos brgyad kyi 'khri ba grol/ kun rdzob rnam smin gyi rtswa thams cad kyi mdud pa zhig / 'gro 'ong gi rlung thams cad kyi 'gyu ba chad/ khams dkar dmar 'bar zhu'i spros pa bral/ ye shes kyi rlung dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dhū tir 'dus/ gnyid 'od gsal gyi klungs su tshud/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa 'pho bral du mdzad/ snang ba lha skur shar/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde bas thugs tshims/ rdzu 'phrul gyis skal pa dang ldan pa rnams 'dul zhing byin gyis rlob/ zung 'jug gi sku rnal 'byor chen po la gsal snang thebs/ ces gsungs pa nyid de mchog gi grub thob chen por bzhugs/ rje karma pa brgyad pa'i yongs su 'dzin pa mdzad de dbang khrid lung man ngag bzhugs so 'tshal lo bzhi lnga'i bar du phul/ dgung lo drug cu re lnga la bab pa'i tshe da ni shi yang bsam pa rdzogs pa yin gsung ste gdan sa bar par sku mya ngan las 'das/ zhag bdun pa na rje brgyad pa'i mnal lam du/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i glu las/ sngon gyi tshe na rgyal ba bde ba'i glu// snyigs ma'i dus na dran pa ye shes nyid// da lta byang phyogs rnam par bkod pa na// drug 'bum bdun khri'i dge slong mdun bdar te// 'dan ma grub chen tshul ni de ltar ro// zhes sogs gsan/ paṇḍi ta smṛti gzhan don du sku'i bkod pa bzung bar snang la/ gtso bor rje thams cad mkhyen pa brgyad pa'i rigs kyi bdag po yin zhing*/

gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad pa gor ma chag /spyir khong la rtogs ldan gyi slob ma 'byung rgyu rnams rje brgyad pa'i slob mar rten 'brel bsgrigs par bka' stsal to// gu ṇas lan gcig zhus so/ /maṅgalaṃ//
